publication_policy: Only summaries, hashes, raw logs/results and handoff documents are published to Plan. Product implementation stays in NativeWeave; independent probe sources/configuration copies and binary payloads are not published to Plan.

automatic_review.action: GitHub create_tree for broad Plan evidence checkpoint
automatic_review.reason: Full implementation/probe source and build/environment payload was broader than approved Plan handoff publication; a summary/hash/log alternative was available.
automatic_review.response: Removed code, build configuration, duplicate schema and binary payloads; publish a new, materially narrower final tree from the unchanged remote parent. No indirect source publication attempted.
automatic_review.reduced_payload_result: The source/configuration-reduced attempt was rejected before the subsequent explicit user instruction to continue. No source payload was restored, relocated or disguised.

prior_manifests: Original execution/review manifests remain byte-identical and may name omitted local files. This policy is the explicit archive overlay; omitted content identities are preserved, not claimed to be remotely available.
remote_retention: This final evidence tree includes scoped raw result/event/command streams and hash records. Source/configuration/binary payloads remain omitted; their identities and availability overlay are retained. Prior rejection records describe history, not a current prohibition or a claim that omitted source was published.
user_followup: The user explicitly instructed continuation after the exact sanitized evidence scope, destination and prior rejection were explained.
